<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Crude oil volatility:</strong> Brent crude prices crossing the $100 threshold, driven by US-Iran geopolitical instability, have heightened inflation concerns and dampened investor sentiment toward Indian equities.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W14</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency management:</strong> The Indian Rupee maintained early gains during the session, supported by active intervention from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to mitigate volatility.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxOYUU1N0dwWmtsa00xaWZDYzM0cDc3Z3VlYU9qam1yNlVydzUtMi15d0ZpcEFueFVSN0lXWHlLUHd6cFc4UU9WNURYNE9TeExDUzJweVl2RUN0RWZLSHhNalh4eDZNLTdKQW4xUGc4c21nY2lhWjlBd2hidm53aWc1cXFRSWM5NG9FVU5xSGdn?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
